title: Rushford-Peterson Elementary 3rd-grade math MCA saw 42 participants in 2024-25
text:
The Minnesota Department of Education reports that third-grade students at Rushford-Peterson Elementary School led all grades in participation rates for the mathematics portion of the 2024-25 MCA.
Among the 138 Rushford-Peterson Elementary students who took the mathematics test, 42 were in third grade.
According to test standards, 57% of third-grade participants were deemed proficient in mathematics.
The MCA and the Alternate Minnesota Comprehensive Assessment (Alt MCA) are state exams used to measure progress toward Minnesota’s academic standards and fulfill legislative requirements. The tests cover subjects such as math, reading, and science at various grade levels. Although the majority of students take the MCA, some in special education who meet specific criteria may take the Alt MCA instead.
Minnesota’s Report Card shows that overall proficiency on the state’s MCA exams has decreased since before the pandemic . For instance, math proficiency fell by more than 7% from 2019, and reading proficiency declined by nearly 5%.
